player_prompt.intro:
Akwaaba Frozen Lake!

Wo 'P' na wo din wɔ grid no so.
Grid symbols:
  ' ' = Frozen surface (faako a wobɛtumi atena)
  'H' = Hole (wotumi wɔ mu na wu saa!)
  'G' = Goal (duro yi na woanya!)
  'P' = Wo dibea seesei

Actions a wotumi yɛ: up, down, left, right (anaa w, a, s, d)
Kyerɛ wo action sɛ: [up], [down], [left], [right] anaa [w], [a], [s], [d]

Botae: Fa wo ho fi aseɛ (soro-konɔ) kɔ goal (aseɛ-nifa) a wɔrenkɔ hole mu!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action format a ɛyɛ saa. Fa [up], [down], [left], [right] anaa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Adwuma a wonnim no '{action}'. Fa di dwuma, soro hɔ fam, benkum so, nifa so anaa w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Wo pɛ sɛ wokɔ {action} nanso wo kɔtoo wall!

game_action.moved: Wɔde {action} kɔ duru beae a ɛyɛ ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Anigyesɛm ne sɛ, woadu botae no ho!
outcome.fell_in_hole: Woahwehwe abura mu! Agoru no awie. Wudii akwantu a ɛkɔ ɔbodan ho {pct}% so nkonim.
outcome.turn_limit: Woadi nea ɛsɛ sɛ wowie! Agoru no awie. Wudii akwantu a ɛkɔ botae no ho {pct}% mu.
